description: Defines the CKEDITOR.dom.node class, a base class for DOM node representations in CKEditor, including methods for node manipulation, traversal, and properties for node types.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.node
classes.description: A class representing a DOM node with methods for manipulation, traversal, and comparison within CKEditor.

methods.name: appendTo
methods.description: Makes this node a child of another element.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of this node, optionally including children and removing IDs.

methods.name: hasPrevious
methods.description: Checks if the node has a previous sibling.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if the node has a next sibling.

methods.name: insertAfter
methods.description: Inserts this node after a specified node.

methods.name: insertBefore
methods.description: Inserts this node before a specified node.

methods.name: insertBeforeMe
methods.description: Inserts a node before this node.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves a unique address for this node within the DOM tree.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Returns the document object containing this node.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of this node among its siblings.

methods.name: getNextSourceNode
methods.description: Gets the next source node in document order, with optional filtering.

methods.name: getPreviousSourceNode
methods.description: Gets the previous source node in document order, with optional filtering.

methods.name: getPrevious
methods.description: Returns the previous sibling node that satisfies an evaluator.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next sibling node that satisfies an evaluator.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent element of this node.

methods.name: getParents
methods.description: Returns all ancestor nodes, optionally with closest first.

methods.name: getCommonAncestor
methods.description: Finds the closest common ancestor with another node.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Determines the position of this node relative to another node.

methods.name: getAscendant
methods.description: Finds the closest ancestor with a specific node name.

methods.name: hasAscendant
methods.description: Checks if an ancestor with a specific node name exists.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves this node to a target node.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes this node from the DOM, optionally preserving children.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces this node with another node.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from both ends of the node's text content.

methods.name: ltrim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the start of the node's text content.

methods.name: rtrim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the end of the node's text content.
